summary.decision_summary: ZSzizzle won by 4.1. ZSzizzle left 1.7 lineup points on the table, while In Purdytory left 17.6.
summary.historical_summary: This is the first recorded meeting between these managers. ZSzizzle leads the manager series 1-0.

summary.winner_reason: ZSzizzle won by 4.1 after scoring -3.5 against projection. The leading starters were Bijan Robinson (32.7) and Lamar Jackson (21.4).
summary.loser_reason: In Purdytory lost by 4.1 even while beating projection by 20.3 points. Lions scored 2.0. Its best legal lineup added 17.6, enough to put the lineup decisions directly in the result.
